step.name: Q: What are the must-visit attractions in Delhi after my flight from Mumbai?
step.text:
A: After your flight from Mumbai, don't miss these must-visit attractions in Delhi:
  • Red Fort: A UNESCO World Heritage site with stunning architecture.
  • Lotus Temple: Known for its flower-like shape and serene atmosphere.
  • Akshardham Temple: A cultural complex showcasing Indian art and architecture.
Each of these sites offers a unique experience that reflects Delhi's rich history and culture!
